notes.title: More updates already?
notes.notes:
You guys requested, I delivered. Here are some updates for V2.0.0.1

notes.title: A quick update on pricing.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I am excited to announce that Clickable Coffee Shop (well, the base game anyway) will be switching business models.

Henceforth, the base game will become free from now on starting asap. DLCs will still have their original price tags.

This is to allow more users to be able to access the game, because let’s face it, a lot of people are reluctant to purchase a game that isn’t very widely known about yet. It requires a lot of trust that the developer has created good quality content (which I of course have tried my best to deliver).

For information about refunds if you have recently purchased the base game:

https://store.steampowered.com/steam_refunds/

If your purchase was not recent, feel free to contact me and we will try to sort something out. 

Thank you for your continued support.

Regards,

A

notes.title: Clickable Coffee Shop V2.0.0.0 is here!
notes.notes:
What's new in Clickable Coffee Shop 2.0.0.0?

Lots:

- Complete UI redesign from the ground up in GMS2. The UI is more attractive than ever before!

- 7 Icons to unlock. Icons replace the original coffee bean's sprite and increases coffee beans per click. They are purchased using premium coffee beans.

- Stats.

- 35 Steam Acheivements!

- Color Themes DLC (coming very quickly).

- Rounding of large numbers (1000 becomes 1K, 1000000 becomes 1M, etc).

- An option to prestige in-game.

- Much quicker performance.

- Several bug fixes.

- and tons more!


and if you're an android user, you're in luck. This game is available for android here:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.game.clickablecoffeeshopandroidedition

the android edition is still in its early phases, but it is very playable and tons of fun.

Also, this version of the game will be available on Mac OS soon.

Enjoy!

notes.title: List of Cheats (Spoiler!) & Plans for the Future.
notes.notes:
[u][b]Current list of cheats for Clickable Coffee Shop as of 2019-08-20[/b][/u]

[i]"aaror874"[/i]: Awards the player $1000 in-game.

[i]"achieved"[/i]: Unlocks all achievements.

[i]"DiscountShopper"[/i]: Everything in the shop costs $1 or 1 coffee bean.

- - - - -

So basically I'm a broke 19 year old Computer Science student who programs in his free time. Clickable Coffee Shop is currently built in Visual Studio using Visual Basic. Recently I purchased GMS2 which will allow me to update and add to this game (Clickable Coffee Shop + Others) in ways I have never imagined possible in Visual Studio. I will post screenshots as I'm remastering it, because I have a lot of really cool ideas in mind for the future. 

However, once CCS is in the finished state that I want it to be in,[i] I will be raising the price slightly, so buy it now while you can for cheap[/i]! (Though the game will still be worth it after the price increase as well, promise!) ;)

After remastering CCS it will be available on both PC and Mac. Mobile app development is also something I want to get into quite soon.

Also I am now working on an original-concept platformer/adventure/rpg type game, where the player gets kicked out of the house at 18 years old and must fend for themselves. Screenshots of my progress on that coming soon as well. The game is titled but I won't say what it is called just yet.

Feel free to suggest new cheats or achievement ideas in the comments and they may be implemented into the game!

notes.title: Clickable Coffee Shop Version 1.0.0.0
notes.notes:
[b]Clickable Coffee Shop[/b] is a very addictive clicker/idle game that I have been developing for the past bit of time.

It starts off very simply; Click on the coffee bean, once you amass enough coffee beans, purchase an upgrade.

You will find, however, that the options in this game open up very quickly which enables the player (you) to have a lot of fun playing it.

There are several upgrades to purchase using in-game currency, and there are 3 types of in-game currency by the way;

[b]Coffee Beans:[/b] The currency that the player has the most access to when the game first starts. It is used to purchase early game upgrades, however if the user collects enough of them they can earn achievements for it.

[b]Premium Coffee Beans:[/b] A rare currency that only increments by 1 every time the user clicks on the coffee bean [i]100[/i] times. As of right now, they are only used to purchase an upgrade called "Faster Harvesting." Although Faster Harvesting is a very useful upgrade in the game, more uses for Premium Coffee Beans are planned for the future.

[b]Money:[/b] Exactly as it sounds. However, this currency is not unlocked until a certain point in the game. Very useful currency indeed.

There are 12 Achievements to unlock as of right now, and also an (experimental) stocks option where the player can purchase stocks in-game and possibly increase (or decrease!) their currency later on when selling them...

I don't want to spoil the game too much, but there is far more than what I just said above inside this game, and there is also a lot more planned for the future. Enjoy!

This game is always in an undergoing state of change, it is planned to be updated very frequently and (constructive please) user input is always welcome.
